tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'cham yig brjed tho bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gter ston chen po mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis lho brag smra bo lcog nas zab gter du spyan drangs pa'i bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad 'bring po'i phyag rgya gar gyi rnam rol rnams rje btsun dam pa ratna'i mtshan can gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams ma 'chug pa thugs kyi sras bla ma ye shes rdo rje la bstsal/ des bla ma sampanna shī la la bstsal ba las rang nyid kyis ji ltar bslabs pa brjed byang nor 'khrul med par bris pa'i dang po/ rnga 'cham gyi thog mar rnga byin brlab ni/ sib rdung gis blangs rjes/ dal rdung gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du rim gyis re re 'phel ba bco lnga nas bcu gsum/ bcu gcig /dgu/ bdun/ lnga/ gsum/ gcig gi bar du re re nas phab pa'i mthar sib rdung gi rjes su/ dang po lam 'gros bzhi rdung phyi 'gros kyis 'don zhing*/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon re re la rnga phab pa dang blang ba bzhi re re phog pa len g.yas/ gnyis pa chig rdung me long ma len g.yon la rnga g.yon du bslangs rkang pa re la rnga lcag re phab nas kyang de mtshungs so// gsum pa bdud rtsi sman mchod nyis rdung len g.yas/ rnga bslangs pa'i rkang pa gnyis rnga lcag gnyis re dang*/ rnga g.yon du sbubs pa gnyis dang*/ slar kha gyen du bstan pa'i rkang pa gnyis la rnga lcag gnyis phog pa/ ldog rnga brda btang nas rnal ma tshar gcig gi steng nas ldog /slar rnal mar 'khor nas nyis rdung gis nang du 'dus nas sman mchod dbyangs dang bcas rgyas par phul/ rjes sib rdung dang phyi 'gros kyis so sor bskyed| bzhi pa slob dpon padma la nyis rdung len g.yas la/ rnga phab slong gi rkang pa re la rnga lcag gnyis re kho na dang*/ rnga g.yon nas g.yas su gan rkyal kho nar 'bebs/ skor ba rnal ma'i thog mar dbyangs ring 'then len pa dang rkang pa g.yas 'degs/

tshig mthar gcig ya la pus 'dzugs dang*/ langs nas he ya la rnga g.yas su 'bebs/ slar ldog nas dbyangs thung 'then pa dang rkang grangs gong ltar yang rnal ma la dbyangs 'cham ldog lta bu'o// lnga pa sum rdung rdo rje pus 'dzugs rnga lcag gcig g.yas su rgyab ma thag /rnga dang rkang pa g.yas nang du khyer la sum rdung gi rwa gsum so sor btsal rjes/ rnga g.yon du 'degs pa gcig dang*/ rkang g.yon phyi la khyer/ yang rnga g.yon du yod bzhin par rkang pa g.yas bteg la rnga lcag gcig de ma thag rkang g.yon bteg cing rnga sgreng bas g.yas su bskor la/ kha rgyab tu bltas pa'i pus 'dzugs dang rnga lcag gcig langs nas rkang g.yon bteg pa'i rwa gsum btsal/ rkang g.yas bteg rnga g.yas su 'degs pa gcig dang*/ g.yon bteg rjes rkang g.yas bteg rnga sgreng bas g.yon du bskor ba la kha nang ltar pus mo btsugs so// drug pa bzhi rdung rgyab skor ma len g.yas/ gzhan lam 'gros lta bu la khyad par rnga phab pa'i g.yas skor la mdun rgyab la rnga kha sbubs la g.yas g.yon du rnga kha brgyan la so sor rnga lcag gnyis re phog pa'o// bdun pa rnga rdung lnga 'gros rnga dal ba gsum dang*/ brel ba gnyis spel ma len g.yas ldog yod/ brgyad pa dzaṃ gsum mchong gsum/ bzhi rdung len g.yon/ rnga g.yon 'degs rkang pa g.yas bteg la bzhi brdung*/ rnga sbubs la g.yas 'degs/ rkang pa g.yas bteg pas bzhi brdung*/ rnga g.yon 'degs sogs sngar ltar byas pas dzaṃ gsum dang*/ de ma thag rkang g.yas bteg phyi la bshud cing cung zad mchongs rjes g.yas pang len gyis g.yon du mchong*/ rnga sbubs nas g.yon pang len gyis g.yas su mchong stabs kyis bskor ba ni/ mchong gsum yin la kha rgyab tu phyogs pas kyang gong ltar bya ba yin no// dgu pa lcags sgrog 'gros chen nyis rdung phyi 'gros rnga gyen du bstan pa'i len g.yon dang*/ rnga mdun du sgreng zhing gom 'gros dang g.yas rtse btsug

/slar gong gi len lta bu de 'dra ba rnga brda dang bcas phyogs bzhir kha blta ba'o// bcu pa rdo rje rkyang 'gros bzhi rdung g.yas su rnga 'degs shing len g.yas/ kha yang phyogs su blta bas kha sbubs la rkang pa g.yas pas rwa gsum btsal rjes rnga bslang rkang pa g.yas bteg g.yon bteg g.yas skor mda' 'gengs kyi rnga dal po gnyis kyis kha 'gro phyogs su bltas la/ rkang pa g.yon pas rwa gsum btsal rjes rnga g.yon 'degs rkang g.yon phyir khyer/ g.yas bteg rnga bsgrengs bas mda' 'gengs rkang pa gnyis bteg pa'i rnga dal po gnyis kyis g.yas skor du rwa 'phos la slar yong phyogs su rkang grangs snga ma brdab pa'o// bcu gcig pa me phung 'gros rnga grangs dang lan rnga rdung lnga 'gros ltar la bzhi lnga la g.yon bteg rnga sbub mdun du phab/ gcig la rnga kha brgyan g.yas bteg rnga kha gnyis la rnga sbub g.yon bteg rgyab blta gsum la rnga brgyan g.yas bteg kha nang du gtad/ bzhi lnga la rnga bslang g.yon dang g.yas pang len gyis phyir skor ldog yod par rkang grangs dang skor ba gong dang 'dra/ bcu gnyis pa lcags sgrog 'gros chung ni/ 'gros chen ltar la de las gom nud chung tsam ltar byas pa kho na yin/ bcu gsum pa sna tshogs rdo rje bzhi rdung len g.yas la/ mdun rgyab kyi rwa rkang pa g.yas dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi rwa rkang pa g.yon pas btsal| rwa snga phyi'i mtshams dang rwa 'pho lugs rkyang 'gros dang 'dra/ bcu bzhi pa rgya mtsho chu ris rnga grangs dang len med dpung 'gros ltar la/ bzhi lnga la g.yon bteg rnga mdun du sbub/ gcig la rnga mdun du brgyan g.yas bteg /gnyis la'ang rnga mdun du sbub g.yon bteg /de ma thag g.yas bteg g.yas su skor ba gsum la rnga g.yas zur 'degs/ bzhi lnga la rkang pa g.yon g.yas 'degs shing rnga bslangs ba lnga rdung lnga 'gros ltar bya/ ldog la'ang rkang grangs snga ma ltar yin/ 'di la rnga slong ba'i tshe me phung 'gros ltar skor ba med do// bco lnga pa/

gtor bshags 'gros bzhi rdung len ltar g.yas dang*/ gzhan lam 'gros la phyi nud med cing ldog yod pa/ bcu drug pa sum rdung pang len yin g.yon rnga bslang rkang pa g.yas bteg sum brdung*| rnga g.yas su 'degs rkang pa g.yon du bteg pa'i sum rdung ngo// bcu bdun pa nyis rdung pang len g.yon rnga grangs ma gtog pang len sum rdung lta bu/ bco brgyad pa sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros nyis rdung dga' ba 'khyil pa'i dbyibs su 'gro zhing 'khyog mtshams su g.yas dang g.yon zur du rnga 'degs thog ma dal phyis brel ba/ bcu dgu pa chig rdung ḍā ru ma len g.yon gom 'khyol dang bcas pa rnga grangs ma gtogs pang len sum rdung gi skabs ltar bya/ nyi shu pa rdo rje phyed sdud bzhi rdung bzhi dang dal po gnyis la nges yod kyi skabs skor ba med pa dang*| nges med la bzhi rdung tha ma la g.yas skor byas pa rnams yin no/// / ༈ /gnyis pa brub 'cham la bsgral las don brgyad ma tshang bar byed dgos pa ste/ thog mar 'cham phran ni/ dgug gzhug drag po dang bcas la/ a tsā ras liṅga khyer ba'i rjes su/ dzaṃ chen pa gnyis chem rdung dal pos mgo sprug dang bcas g.yas g.yon du don rjes/ rnga dal po gnyis kyis g.yas phyir khyer la/ g.yon pang len byas g.yon nang du mchongs la rnga dal po lnga dang brel ba bdun re spel ba'i g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang 'gying tshul lag len ltar byed/ de rjes dgug gzhug dang bcas dgu bskor ba gnyis chem rdung gis don la rnga dal po gnyis kyis g.yas phyir khyer/ g.yon pang len byas nang du mchongs la rnga brel po dgu dang dal po bzhi spel ba la dgu phyi nang gi mtshams su bskor ba phyed re dang bcas pa yin no// de rjes dgug gzhug dang bcas nyis 'gros pa gnyis chem rdung gis don la rnga dal po gcig gis g.yas su mchong*/ slar bzhi rdung dang bcas rkang pa g.yas nang du mchongs pa'i nyis 'gros g.yon nang du mchong skabs mgo sprug gnyis re zur du bya zhing gdong zur sprad la gom 'khyol dang bcas pa byed/

de rjes smug nag gru gsum ma che ba'i dbyangs kyi mthar bco lnga brdung gi nyung 'don g.yas g.yon gang rung gi pang len gyi mchong gsum gyis liṅga'i rtsar phyin gris brdegs nas g.yas phyir dor/ g.yon pang len gyis nang du mchongs la g.yon skor gnyis dang g.yas gdengs/ g.yas skor gnyis dang g.yas gdengs bya'o// brub 'cham dngos la dgug gzhug drag po gsum mam gcig gi mthar dam can spyi bskul dang*/ pho nya sgos bskul byas la rnga sib rdung gi rjes su bzhi rdung bzhi dang dal ba gnyis kyi lam 'gros chen mos 'cham mang 'don pa ni che mchog gis sna drangs/ bzhi rdung snga ma sum gnyis 'gros dkyus ma la/ bzhi rdung phyi ma'i gcig gnyis la lag gnyis g.yas su brdeg /gsum bzhi la mdun| lnga drug la g.yas su brdeg /bdun brgyad la lag gnyis mdun du bkug /dgu gnyis la g.yas rol g.yon rol bya'o// de rjes che mchog nas ma mo'i bar gyi dbyangs thung ba dang*| dmod bcol nyis 'gros dal po dang bcas pa bya ba'am/ long med na tshig rnams lhag chad med par 'don/ de rjes bruub 'cham gyi dang po 'cham rtsa ni/ ma mo'i dbyangs kyis nyis 'gros dal po bya/ slar dmod bcol phur bu dal tshul byas la chig rdung dal pos g.yas 'gying g.yon 'gying dang bar du gom 'khyol dal po bya/ phaṭa rgyab g.yas g.yon du gcu zhing ldog byas la phur dar bsgyur/ de rjes phyi la phur dar bsgyur/ gsum pa rkang g.yon 'degs/ nang du liṅga la phur pa brdeg /gsum la rkang pa g.yas 'degs/ de rjes kha nang du bltas te rkang pa g.yon bteg /lag pa snying gar bsnol rkang pa g.yas bteg lag pa dang mgo mdun du sprug /g.yas rgyab g.yon du'ang de 'dra re bya ba phyogs bzhi'i mgo sprug /chig rdung brel po ni/ drag g.yom gnyis g.yas g.yon du bslang g.yas rol g.yon rol gom 'khyol cung zad brel po bya/ slar phaṭa rgyab ldog phur dar bskyur/

bzhi rdung gis g.yas g.yon du g.yom bslang*/ rkang pa g.yon pas nyis rdung dang g.yas pas nyis 'gros bslang phaṭa rgyab ldog phur dar bskyur/ g.yas nang du mchongs slar g.yas kyis dgu skor byas/ de rjes bzhi rdung gis g.yon dang nyis 'gros bya'o// gnyis pa baṃ dang po ni/ nyis 'gros gong ltar las phaṭa rgyab ldog phur dar bskyur/ g.yas nang du mchongs/ slar g.yas phyir dor/ g.yon nang du dor/ de rjes g.yas nang du rol pa bzhi rnams nyis rdung*/ slar bzhi rdung gcig gi mthar g.yon phyir dor nang du bskor gnyis rdung bzhi dang bzhi rdung gcig bya/ de rjes g.yas pang len gyis g.yon dang*/ g.yon pang len gyis g.yas su padma re re bskor/ slar g.yom dang nyis 'gros bya'o// gsum pa baṃ bar pa ni/ g.yom dang nyis 'gros phaṭa rgyab ldog phur dar bskyur/ g.yon pang len gyis g.yas dang g.yas pas g.yon/ g.yon pas g.yas su padma gsum bskor/ g.yom bzhi bslang*/ brdab gcig bya/ g.yas phyir mchong brdab gcig bya/ g.yon phyir mchong brdab gcig byas/ g.yas phyir mchong g.yom bzhi bslang*/ brdab gcig byas la/ g.yon pang len gyis g.yas dang*/ g.yas pang len gyis g.yon| g.yon pang len gyis g.yas su padma gsum bskor/ de ni g.yon gyi padma dgu dang*/ mchong gsum g.yom brgyad/ brdab bzhi'o// de bzhin du g.yas g.yon gom pa rjes la bya'o| |bzhi pa baṃ tha ma ni/ g.yom bslang nyis 'gros bya phaṭa rgyab ldog phur dar bskyur la nyis rdung gis g.yas nang du mchong*/ slar g.yas phyir bskyed/ g.yon nang du mchong*/ de rjes rkang pa g.yas bteg /g.yon pas 'gro phyogs su dgu brtsegs g.yon phyir khyer g.yas nang du mchong*/ rkang pa g.yon bteg g.yas pas yongs su dgu brtsegs// de rjes g.yas pang len gyis g.yon dang*/ g.yon pang len gyis g.yas su padma re re bskor/ g.yom bslang*/ nyis 'gros bya'o// lnga pa baṃ tha ma'i tha ma ni/ gzhan thams cad ni tha ma dang 'dra ba la khyad par ni g.yas g.yon gyi dgu skor gnyis ka nang ngos su mchong ba yin no// de rjes g.yom bslang nyis 'gros kyis nang du bsdu'o/

/skabs 'dir zor 'og tu 'byung ba ltar bya'o/// / ༈ /drug pa bsgral zhing gnas spar zhal du bstab pa ni/ nyis 'gros gsum dang*/ gdong gsig gsum dang*/ g.yas phyir khyer g.yon nang du bskor bas 'don/ mchod bstod kyi dbyangs dang nyis 'gros dal po bya'o// dmod bcol byas la g.yom bslang*/ nyis 'gros bya phaṭa rgyab ldog phur dar bskyur la/ nang du drag g.yom gsum dang*/ phyir zhing g.yom gsum re spel ba gsum bya phaṭa rgyab/ bzhi rdung gnyis re'i rdo rje phyed sdud dgu ma brtsegs pas liṅga bsgral/ de rjes g.yom dang nyis 'gros bya'o// 'di'i nyis 'gros dang g.yom dal brel 'tsham pa zhig bya ba sngar slob dpon gyis mdzad pa mthong ba ltar bya/ kha cig 'dir g.yom brel so ma nyis 'gros dal po byas zer ba ni rang bzo'i rtog brtag 'ba' zhig tu snang bas yid brtan mi 'dug go// de rjes drag sngags kyi dbyangs dang nyis 'gros dal po bya/ dmod bcol gyis ling ro 'then la/ g.yon pas gdong gsig gsum dang*/ g.yas pas dgu skor byas rjes/ g.yom dang nyis 'gros brel po bya/ de rjes bstab dbyangs dang po dang*/ bzhi skor gyis 'gro phyogs/ bar mas yong phyogs/ tha mas nang du gtor ma la ling ro dbul/ bstab dbyangs dang po zhi ba/ bar pa che mchog /de rjes yang dag nas drag sngags kyi bar sil 'don dang*/ bstab dbyangs tha ma bka' srung gis dbul| ling ro phul ba'i sib rdung gi tshe yab gcig dpal chen sogs rdzogs par byas rjes/ phyir gshegs la lag pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgyas phur rtse gyen du bstan pa snying gi dkyil du bzhag pa chos sku/ g.yas pas longs sku/ g.yon pas sprul skur gnas spar ba tshe lung khrus lung*/ de rjes 'gying bag dang bcas pas/ gom 'khyol gyis g.yas rol dang*/ lag pa snying khar pad kor byas rjes g.yon dkur brten g.yas bsgrengs bas g.yas bskor bya/ g.yon la'ang phyag rgya bsgyur la bya ba ni dga' ba 'khyil bas lha rnams tshim par bya'o// de rjes phaṭa rgyab rdo rje gdan pa g.yas nyis 'gros la g.yon sngar lam 'gros chen mo'i bzhi rdung phyi ma'i skabs ltar byas/

slar phaṭa rgyab rdo rje chig sdud bzhi rdung gsum gyi mthar mgo sprug gnyis dang g.yas gdengs g.yon snying kha g.yon gdengs g.yas snying khar bzhag /des nang du bsdu ba yin no/// / ༈ /mthar rlung nag 'tshub mas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba na/ chem rdung drag pos mgo sprug dang bcas g.yas rol g.yon rol gyis don la/ chig g.yom gnyis dang 'gros stabs g.yas 'gying g.yon 'gying dang dgu mthar mgo sprug gyen gsig dang bcas pa bya phaṭa rgyab/ dgu rdung gi bzhi g.yon skor dang bzhi g.yas skor dgu mthar mgo sprug gyen gsig dang bcas pa nges yod dang dgu'i gcig g.yon skor byed la/ de phyin g.yas skor mgo sprug gyen gsig dang bcas pa ni nges med/ de gnyis ka'i mgo sprug la g.yas 'degs gyen gsig g.yon 'degs/ de dag gis nang du bsdu'o// zor ni zor bskul dbyangs dang bcas pa'i mthar/ bco lnga brdungs la 'gying stabs g.yas g.yon mang nyung skabs sbyar gyi mthar g.yas gdengs rkang pa g.yas phyir bzhag /g.yon gdengs rkang pa g.yon gyis mchong zhing zur bshal g.yon skor phyed gnyis kyis rgyab tu kha blta bas g.yas gdengs/ g.yon gdengs/ g.yas kyis mchong zhing zur bshal g.yas skor phyed gnyis kyis kha nang blta/ slar snga ma lta bus zor pa brgyad dam bcu drug 'don/ dpal chen brgyad kyi bskul gyi skabs dbyangs len pa dang rkang pa g.yas 'degs/ tshig dang po'i he ya bar ma gtogs rkang pa re la rnga lcag gnyis re 'phog /g.yas phyag gi skabs g.yas gdengs/ g.yon dkur brten pa'i g.yas skor/ g.yon phyag gi skabs g.yon gdengs/ g.yas dkur brten pa'i g.yon skor/ gzhan thams cad skor ba phyed phyed/ bka' sdod rab 'jigs lcags kyus zung*/ gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams g.yon snying kha dang g.yas phur phu 'debs tshul bya/ dzaḥ'i rjes su g.yas phyir khyer/ slar g.yon gdengs kyis bco lnga rdung skor ba gdengs tshul sngar 'don gyi skabs ltar bya tshul de lta bus bskul/

brgyad ka 'then nam/ bzhi gsum gcig sogs dbyangs gang byed dang*/ dbyangs ma byas pa rnams sil 'don bya/ phur thun mtshon bskul gyi zor rdeg ni dbyangs len pa dang rkang g.yas 'degs/ 'di la g.yas skor g.yon skor phyed phyed ma gtogs skor ba dang rdeg stangs med/ dzaḥ'i mthar bzhi skor gyis nang du phyin la zor brdeg /phyi 'gros kyis log la g.yom gsum dgu skor bya/ zor rdzas brgyad po thebs nas rdo rje phyed sdud nges med kyis nang du bsdu ba yin no// sgo dbye gser skyems ni/ 'don dgos mi dgos yul skabs dang bstun/ dngos gzhi phyogs bzhi'i gser skyems ni/ zor rdzas brgyad po'i skabs kyi dbyangs 'cham kho na yin/ bsdu dgos na phyed sdud nyis 'gros gang rung gis bsdu'o// de ltar rnga 'cham dang brub 'cham zor sgo dbye dang bcas par so so'i go yul dmigs pa yin lugs sogs bshad pa mang du 'dug kyang 'dir ma bris so// de dag gis bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rnga 'cham yongs rdzogs lhad med du bris pa der/ khrag 'thung dang phur pa sogs dkyil 'khor re re'i rtsa 'cham la gtsigs chen du byed pa las 'phags la/ 'di nyid gter ston nas da lta'i bar du bsgral 'cham gyi 'don ma gtogs khrigs chags star chags 'di ga las gzhan pa'i rang bzo kha 'gengs chad lhag spu tsam med pas/ slad kyis 'di legs mdzes kyi rang bzo dang kha 'gengs bcos lhad mi bya ba dang*/ nyams mtshar bzhad gad kyi ched du min zhing bka' srung ches gnyan pas khro rol dang sgrub chen gyi skabs las gzhan du byed na bde 'dus kyi las byang tshar re 'gro dgos pa rnams ni gong ma'i phyag bzhes gtsang ma mi bar khyis ma chod cing chu dang 'o ma ma 'dres pa kho na yin no// de ltar bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'cham yig mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang dam pa'i chos 'di la blo smin par byas pa/

'bri gung pa skyu ra'i rigs las dus mtha'i sngags 'chang che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes sam/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig padma 'od du mgyogs par bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
